name: autorecon
summary: A multi-threaded network reconnaissance tool which performs automated enumeration of services.
highlights: -p — Comma separated list of ports / port ranges to scan. Specify TCP/UDP ports by prepending l
-m — The maximum number of concurrent scans to run. Default: 50
-mp — The maximum number of concurrent port scans to run. Default: 10 (approx 20% of max-scans u
-c — Location of AutoRecon's config file. Default: /root/.config/AutoRecon/config.toml
-g — Location of AutoRecon's global file. Default: /root/.config/AutoRecon/global.toml
--tags — Tags to determine which plugins should be included. Separate tags by a plus symbol (+) to
--exclude-tags — Tags to determine which plugins should be excluded. Separate tags by a plus symbol (+) to

flags.name: --target-file
flags.description: Read targets from file.

flags.name: --ports
flags.description: Comma separated list of ports / port ranges to scan. Specify TCP/UDP ports by prepending list with T:/U: To scan both TCP/UDP, put port(s) at start or specify B: e.g. 53,T:21-25,80,U:123,B:123. Default: None

flags.name: --max-scans
flags.description: The maximum number of concurrent scans to run. Default: 50

flags.name: --max-port-scans
flags.description: The maximum number of concurrent port scans to run. Default: 10 (approx 20% of max-scans unless specified)

flags.name: --config
flags.description: Location of AutoRecon's config file. Default: /root/.config/AutoRecon/config.toml

flags.name: --global-file
flags.description: Location of AutoRecon's global file. Default: /root/.config/AutoRecon/global.toml

flags.name: --tags
flags.description: Tags to determine which plugins should be included. Separate tags by a plus symbol (+) to group tags together. Separate groups with a comma (,) to create multiple groups. For a plugin to be included, it must have all the tags specified in at least one group. Default: default

flags.name: --exclude-tags
flags.description: Tags to determine which plugins should be excluded. Separate tags by a plus symbol (+) to group tags together. Separate groups with a comma (,) to create multiple groups. For a plugin to be excluded, it must have all the tags specified in at least one group. Default: None

flags.name: --port-scans
flags.description: Override --tags / --exclude-tags for the listed PortScan plugins (comma separated). Default: None

flags.name: --service-scans
flags.description: Override --tags / --exclude-tags for the listed ServiceScan plugins (comma separated). Default: None

flags.name: --reports
flags.description: Override --tags / --exclude-tags for the listed Report plugins (comma separated). Default: None

flags.name: --plugins-dir
flags.description: The location of the plugins directory. Default: /root/.local/share/AutoRecon/plugins

flags.name: --add-plugins-dir
flags.description: The location of an additional plugins directory to add to the main one. Default: None

flags.name: --list
flags.description: List all plugins or plugins of a specific type. e.g. --list, --list port, --list service

flags.name: --output
flags.description: The output directory for results. Default: results

flags.name: --single-target
flags.description: Only scan a single target. A directory named after the target will not be created. Instead, the directory structure will be created within the output directory. Default: False

flags.name: --only-scans-dir
flags.description: Only create the "scans" directory for results. Other directories (e.g. exploit, loot, report) will not be created. Default: False

flags.name: --no-port-dirs
flags.description: Don't create directories for ports (e.g. scans/tcp80, scans/udp53). Instead store all results in the "scans" directory itself. Default: False

flags.name: --heartbeat
flags.description: Specifies the heartbeat interval (in seconds) for scan status messages. Default: 60

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: Specifies the maximum amount of time in minutes that AutoRecon should run for. Default: None

flags.name: --target-timeout
flags.description: Specifies the maximum amount of time in minutes that a target should be scanned for before abandoning it and moving on. Default: None

flags.name: --nmap
flags.description: Override the {nmap_extra} variable in scans. Default: -vv --reason -Pn -T4

flags.name: --nmap-append
flags.description: Append to the default {nmap_extra} variable in scans. Default:

flags.name: --proxychains
flags.description: Use if you are running AutoRecon via proxychains. Default: False

flags.name: --disable-sanity-checks
flags.description: Disable sanity checks that would otherwise prevent the scans from running. Default: False

flags.name: --disable-keyboard-control
flags.description: Disables keyboard control ([s]tatus, Up, Down) if you are in SSH or Docker.

flags.name: --ignore-plugin-checks
flags.description: Ignores errors from plugin check functions that would otherwise prevent AutoRecon from running. Default: False

flags.name: --accessible
flags.description: Attempts to make AutoRecon output more accessible to screenreaders. Default: False

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: Enable verbose output. Repeat for more verbosity.

flags.name: --version
flags.description: Prints the AutoRecon version and exits.

flags.name: --help
flags.description: Show this help message and exit.

flags.name: --curl.path
flags.description: The path on the web server to curl. Default: /

flags.name: --dirbuster.tool
flags.description: The tool to use for directory busting. Default: feroxbuster

flags.name: --dirbuster.threads
flags.description: The number of threads to use when directory busting. Default: 10

flags.name: --dirbuster.ext
flags.description: The extensions you wish to fuzz (no dot, comma separated). Default: txt,html,php,asp,aspx,jsp

flags.name: --dirbuster.recursive
flags.description: Enables recursive searching (where available). Warning: This may cause significant increases to scan times. Default: False

flags.name: --dirbuster.extras
flags.description: Any extra options you wish to pass to the tool when it runs. e.g. --dirbuster.extras='-s 200,301 --discover- backup'

flags.name: --enum4linux.tool
flags.description: The tool to use for doing Windows and Samba enumeration. Default: enum4linux-ng

flags.name: --onesixtyone.community-strings
flags.description: The file containing a list of community strings to try. Default: /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/SNMP/common-snmp- community-strings-onesixtyone.txt

flags.name: --redirect-host-discovery.update-hosts
flags.description: If set, discovered redirect hostnames will be added to /etc/hosts with the target IP

flags.name: --subdomain-enum.domain
flags.description: The domain to use as the base domain (e.g. example.com) for subdomain enumeration. Default: None

flags.name: --subdomain-enum.threads
flags.description: The number of threads to use when enumerating subdomains. Default: 10

flags.name: --vhost-enum.hostname
flags.description: The hostname to use as the base host (e.g. example.com) for virtual host enumeration. Default: None

flags.name: --vhost-enum.threads
flags.description: The number of threads to use when enumerating virtual hosts. Default: 10

flags.name: --wpscan.api-token
flags.description: An API Token from wpvulndb.com to help search for more vulnerabilities.

flags.name: --global.username-wordlist
flags.description: A wordlist of usernames, useful for bruteforcing. Default: /usr/share/seclists/Usernames/top-usernames- shortlist.txt

flags.name: --global.password-wordlist
flags.description: A wordlist of passwords, useful for bruteforcing. Default: /usr/share/seclists/Passwords/darkweb2017-top100.txt

flags.name: --global.domain
flags.description: The domain to use (if known). Used for DNS and/or Active Directory. Default: None

examples.explanation: Perform reconnaissance on target host(s) (detailed scan results will be dumped in `results`)
Perform reconnaissance on target(s) from a file
Output results to a different directory
Limit scanning to specific ports and protocols (`T` for TCP, `U` for UDP, `B` for both)
